'''2008 Virginia State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played in Virginia on 23 August 2008.<ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref> [[Bentley Boyd]] won the final confrontation against [[Winston Plunkett]] and received the bye into Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship|World Championship]]; six players took part.<ref name="sf-22028-332124">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332124#p332124 VA States 2008], mr007agent (Michael Richards), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref><ref name="sf-22028-332117">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332117#p332117 VA States 2008], simone89 (Cedric Simon), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008).</ref>

== Organization ==

On 26 July 2008 [[Scott Lingrell]] told the tournament director, addressed as Trevin, that the Players Committee's packet for the event included flyers to fill in and put up in the store.<ref name="sf-22028-318318">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=318318#p318318 VA States 2008], Advocate (Scott Lingrell), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (26 July 2008).</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Virginia<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
* '''Dates:''' 23 August 2008<ref name="sf-22883-332133" />
* '''Format:''' Swiss with a final confrontation<ref name="sf-22028-332124" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Bentley Boyd]]<ref name="sf-22028-332124" />

== Results ==

Plunkett finished the Swiss rounds first on points, but Boyd won the final confrontation 4 (+23) to 0 (−23).<ref name="sf-22028-332124" /> Cedric Simon recorded the Day 2 bid for Boyd on 29 August 2008.<ref name="sf-22028-332117" />
